list: the official 55 trophies, as published 18 November 2026
listSources: Exophase trophy list and PSNProfiles trophy list (reported by Push Square, 18 Nov 2026); names, descriptions and grades cross-checked against GTABase, Output Lag and Press Start, which all agree with the kit
note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as published. Guides are written in our own words for this guide. Anything not yet confirmed at launch is labelled unconfirmed rather than guessed. Trophy 4 keeps the asterisks exactly as published.

trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done. In practice that means finishing A Long Road, the 100% completion Gold, since everything else feeds into it. Expect around 200 hours for the full run, most of it on the 100% checklist after the story.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Play the story and pick up side content as it appears; nothing here needs a second playthrough.
After the credits, work the 100% checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
Finish the Strangers & Freaks strands and the side-character finales last.
When A Long Road pops, this Platinum follows immediately.

trophies.guide: The opening mission of Chapter 1, so it pops early and cannot be missed. Play through Gone Fishing as the story directs and the trophy follows the mission's end. There is no mission replay, so make a manual save before you start if you want a clean Chapter 1 save to return to.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Start the story and follow the Gone Fishing objectives.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops as it ends.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full. It actually pops a little late: once you have played the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 first, though — that feeds the possibly missable Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Play through every Chapter 1 mission.
Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Start Chapter 2 and play What's in the Bag?; the trophy pops then.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it pops just after the chapter turns over: as Chapter 3 begins, after the mission Welcome to Vice City. The name is shown with asterisks exactly as PlayStation publishes it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Play through every Chapter 2 mission.
Finish the chapter, then play Welcome to Vice City at the start of Chapter 3.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, rather than on the final cutscene of Chapter 3 itself. Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 4: with no mission replay, a chapter-start save is your only way back to anything you skipped.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Play through every Chapter 3 mission.
Start Chapter 4 and play Ocean Beach, then Another Life.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and the trophy pops. It cannot be missed: just keep playing the story missions in order until the chapter closes. Before the chapter's last missions, make a manual save you can return to, since there is no mission replay and the bank-vault content of Chapter 4 is worth revisiting.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Play through every Chapter 4 mission in order.
Finish the chapter; the trophy pops as it closes.

trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of the story. This is the second Gold and the story's end, not the Platinum's: free roam carries on after the credits, so you can clean up everything else afterwards. There is no mission replay, but no trophy depends on how you play a mission.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Keep a manual save from just before the final mission.
Play the final mission to its end.
After the credits, keep playing in free roam for the clean-up trophies.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission. Play it when the story offers it and the trophy pops at the mission's end. Chapter 2 is also when switching between Jason and Lucia opens up, so most of the free-roam list starts here.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
Complete the mission as directed.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It pops when that mission ends, so there is nothing extra to do beyond playing the story. Chapter 3 is where the robbery tools start arriving, so keep the heist's lessons in mind for the vault and truck trophies later.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Complete the mission as directed.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for Child's Play in Chapter 4. Play the mission through to its end and the trophy follows. Chapter 4 is the last chapter with new robbery content, so use the missions here to learn the vault and gang-operation routines the 100% checklist will want later.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Reach Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission as directed.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for Headliners in Chapter 4. Finish the mission and the trophy pops with it. Like the other mission trophies it needs no extra work: play the mission, finish it, and move on to the next chapter.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Reach Headliners in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission as directed.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Play the mission to its end; the trophy is awarded with the mission, not for anything you do in free roam. The airport itself matters later too: the jet you need for Catch Me If You Can is parked at these same gates.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission as directed.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5, the last chapter. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. After it, only the final mission stands between you and the post-story clean-up, so keep a save from before the finale.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Complete the mission as directed.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the longest grind: the 100% checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion only appears after the story, but everything you did earlier already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It does not ask for everything: some lines need the full amount, others only a share. Full amounts: all robberies (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations), underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races, and Bret's 15 Target Decks. Shares: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Turn on every progress and collectible notification in the settings early.
During the story, scan vehicles with WAiNK, study animals with binoculars, and meditate with both characters.
After the credits, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work the list top to bottom.
Leave the long grinds (stunts, challenges, races) for the post-story clean-up; most of them overlap with other trophies.

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to pile them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250. Track your count under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and turn on the map's Stunt Spot markers.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Fly under bridges for the fastest count; stunt jumps are the next easiest.
Ignore the optional challenge on each stunt; it is not required.
Check Progress, Activities, Stunts for your running total.
Keep going to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race), and a stunt. Progress, Activities shows what is left. Most of these come naturally while you chase the other trophies, so check the list before grinding any one of them.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Open Progress, Activities to see which of the 9 types you still need.
Try the missing ones in any order; one attempt at each is enough.
A race win counts for the race type, and any stunt counts for the stunt type.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds in total. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger, so do them before you try that trophy. Take your time on each range's target pattern rather than rushing the timer.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Visit a shooting range and work through its challenges one by one.
Repeat a challenge until you earn gold; silver or bronze does not count.
Finish all 42 golds; your Focus level rises as you go.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so you may as well finish every race at a location while you are there.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location and win one race there.
Repeat at all 14 locations.
While there, win the location's other races too for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from. Winning the same race again does not count, so keep moving to fresh races instead of replaying a favourite. If a race keeps beating you, come back with a faster car or after upgrading, rather than grinding the same loss.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Pick a race you have not won yet and win it.
Move on to a new race each time; repeats do not count.
20 different wins across the 40 races pops the trophy.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and then beat him in his challenge. Bring a decent rod and keep your line steady rather than reeling hard the whole time.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Meet Cal in Feng Shui in Chapter 1.
Follow his texts to the purple fishing spot and play his quests.
Beat Cal in his fishing challenge.

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind) are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick the one whose controls click for you and play it through.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Play an arcade game at home on the TV or on a cabinet around Leonida.
Reach the end of the game; any of the four counts.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The last one awards the trophy. They stay available after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: In Chapter 3, wait for Andy's text and go to the Belville address as Lucia.
Do the five quests in order.
Finish Puff Puff Pass; the trophy pops then.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton, the green KR icon in Key Lento, hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then. Track it under Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Find Kenton (green KR icon) in Key Lento in Chapter 1.
Dive at the purple chest markers at the 7 shipwrecks and dig up the treasure with the metal detector.
When Kenton texts Jason again later, finish his last mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy. They stay available after the story, so do them in a row while you are at the Mudclub and tick the whole line off in one visit.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Do Billy's five jobs in order.
Finish Hometown Heroes, the fifth job.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed at launch, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list after each strand you finish. One warning: the Chapter 3 race against Yago, Race Against Yago, is time-sensitive (hourglass icon), so save first and race it the moment it appears. None of these strands are needed for 100%, and all of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide; Output Lag trophy list
steps: Finish stranger strands and watch the trophy's progress counter after each one.
Save before Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 and do it as soon as it appears.
Keep going until 8 qualifying strands are done; Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's lines do not count.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look. Cars in better condition pay more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: After Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3, open Randy's Wish List.
Scan cars with WAiNK to find the 16 on his list.
Deliver each one to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job, Shut Down the Labs, awards the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, play as Jason.
Destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City.
Finish his last job, Shut Down the Labs.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. This is the one trophy reported as possibly missable: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide; Output Lag trophy list
steps: In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony and meditate with her.
After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, bring your partner to every meditation spot so each counts twice.
Meditate at all 18 spots; watch the counter under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet at launch; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so finish the decks and it should follow.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, answer Bret's text and start Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) as Jason.
Work through all 15 Target Decks for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets; you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is, so pick the three nearest to done and finish those first. Cards you find while exploring count even before you know the sets, so check Collections after each session.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Open Progress, Collections to see each card set's progress.
Pick the three sets closest to complete.
Finish those three sets.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel rather than hunting them all at once, and the 100% checklist's share (100 scans) comes along the way.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Open the WAiNK phone app (hold Up, then R1 / RB).
Scan Landmarks, Curiosities, Sculptures and No Flusher tags as you pass them.
Reach 100 scanned spots.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress, Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way. Check the list now and then and steer toward the ones nearly done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Open Progress, Challenges to see what is ticked and what is close.
Play normally; most challenges finish on their own.
Steer toward nearly finished ones until 50 are ticked.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape. It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone, not just out of sight. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner in.
Get a 4-star Wanted Level.
Escape until you are fully out of the red heat zone.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together, which makes the chain easy. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Bring your partner and stock up on armor, sticky bombs and healing items.
Rob three shops in a row without letting the wanted level drop.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop; rob a fourth if it has not popped.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Open the WAiNK app near busy traffic.
Scan 100 different vehicles; driving them is not needed.
Keep scanning toward 200 base models for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Fill your Focus first: eat, drink or wash up at home, and take Adrenaline.
Find a group of gang operation thugs.
Aim, click both sticks for Combat Focus, and take down 5 of them in that one use.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport (VCIA), steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge; planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge. The trophy is delayed, so keep flying until it pops, and save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide; Output Lag trophy list
steps: Save first, then go to VCIA and head for gates E3 or E4.
Board a big passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge.
Back out, take off, and fly about 1 km from the airport until it pops.

trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County; the tanks are at the south end of the base. Take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. Save first: the base is guarded and the response is heavy.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Save first, then go to Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island.
Find the tanks at the south end of the base and get in one.
Take out enemies from inside the tank until it pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Use the Snap Gun on a locked back door; do not kick it in.
Find the safe code note in the back room, empty the safe unseen, and leave.

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 if you want a head start.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Finish the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….
Follow a security van to its bank and enter the vault while it is open.
Hand a bag to your partner, then escape the 4-star wanted level.
Rob 5 vaults; all 8 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) counts, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray. Before that, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Box in an armored truck so it cannot drive off.
Stick a bomb on its back doors, blow them open and take the cash.
Escape the red heat zone, or reach a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch until the map is fully revealed. It pairs naturally with the stunt flying you need for Cunning Stunts.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Take a plane and fly over every dark patch of the map.
Keep going until no fog is left on the map of Leonida.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress, Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops along the way. Do a different gang's operation each time until all 9 are covered.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Find an illegal operation (yellow map icon) for a gang you have not robbed yet.
Rob it and check Progress, Gangs for the count.
Repeat until all 9 gangs are covered.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. That is what the description points to, but the exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch, so this guide will not guess them: check the sources below for the first confirmed method, and try the Ocean Beach bars with a view in the meantime.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide (method unconfirmed)
steps: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City.
Look for a bar with a view and order a cocktail.
Method unconfirmed at launch: watch the cited guide for the confirmed steps.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom, in the style of the classic opening. The exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch, so this guide will not guess a specific showroom: try driving a car through a showroom's front window, and check the sources below for the first confirmed method.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide (method unconfirmed)
steps: Find a vehicle showroom with a big front window.
Drive a car through the window and out.
Method unconfirmed at launch: watch the cited guide for the confirmed steps.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back, so get them all if you can.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Take the Hit Kingpin Bowling job in Chapter 2 to mark Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Bring sticky bombs and take the watch, the shotgun and the safe contents.
Lose the police; the trophy pops then.

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason & Lucia, Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map, Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home. It is a slow build, so start early and top it up between missions.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Buy a gym membership and train at a fitness club with your partner along.
Keep training until both Jason and Lucia reach maximum Strength.
Check Jason & Lucia, Strength in the pause menu for the count.

trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI to watch the count. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind. One warning: do not push towards the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI.
Play normally; robberies and fights raise the count.
Avoid pushing towards the Irredeemable profile; it is permanent.

trophies.guide: "Second time's the charm" suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. The exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch, so this guide will not guess them: a retry-based moment is the best reading of the description, and the sources below will carry the first confirmed method.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide (method unconfirmed)
steps: The description points to succeeding on a second attempt.
Method unconfirmed at launch: watch the cited guide for the confirmed steps.

trophies.guide: Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida. The exact trigger is not confirmed yet at launch, so this guide will not guess a location: the description reads like a one-off odd moment, and the sources below will carry the first confirmed method.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide (method unconfirmed)
steps: Watch for a strange event or Easter egg while exploring Leonida.
Method unconfirmed at launch: watch the cited guide for the confirmed steps.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle (a melee drive-by). The exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch, so this guide will not guess a spot or a count: try a melee swing from a slow-moving vehicle at pedestrians, and check the sources below for the first confirmed method.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide (method unconfirmed)
steps: From a slow-moving vehicle, swing a melee attack at people on foot.
Method unconfirmed at launch: watch the cited guide for the confirmed steps.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there without a separate grind.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Finish Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 for the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Sell the bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most, until $250,000 is laundered.

trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest, so buy what you actually want to use and the trophy arrives on its own. It counts across all shops, not in one visit.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Spend across any shops; guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest.
Keep the running total in mind; it counts across all shops.
Reach $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count, so you still need all 8 bought ones. Buy cheap ones first if money is tight.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: After Daily Driver in Chapter 2, open the Vice City Real Estate phone app.
Buy all 8 garages for sale (about $160,000 in total).
Story-given garages do not count toward the 8.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Exophase trophy list; GTABase trophy guide
steps: Finish Moses' Chapter 2 mission to get the Scooter Bros app.
Take a stolen vehicle to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray it, then register it.
Register 10 vehicles; from Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones too.
